titulo: Why The Rich Keep Getting Richer
descripcion:
On a tiny island, seashells are money. The chief finds a hidden beach full of them, and an old woman's life savings quietly lose half their value without her spending a single shell.

The real idea behind it: when the amount of money grows faster than the goods it buys, every coin buys less. That's inflation, and it hits savers hardest.

The island, the chief and Mele are made up; the economics is real.

So who robbed her: the chief who found the shells, or the fisherman who raised the price? 👇
